desc: Validate the combinatorial reduction and naive recurrence with brute force for small N, including direct prefix-cut checking and sample verification.
Implement optimized NTT utilities for mod 998244353 (primitive root 3), factorial/invfactorial precomputation, and memory-safe convolution helpers.

Implement an efficient O(N log^2 N) or better computation of the recurrence B[c] = -invfact[T[c]-c] * (fact[T[c]] + sum_{d<c, T[d]>=d} B[d]*fact[T[c]-d]) using CDQ divide-and-conquer with NTT for the online convolution and naive multiplication for small segments.
Integrate the efficient solver into the final stdin/stdout Python program, handle edge cases, and run sample plus random small-N tests against the brute-force validator.
